rdfs:label: image
rdfs:comment: An image of the subject — typically a representative picture (avatar, cover, depiction).
notes: Property form paired with the `urn:solid:Image` class. Maps to `schema:image`, the most widely deployed property for representative pictures (used by Open Graph consumers, search engines, and most social platforms). For the FOAF tradition, `urn:solid:img` (foaf:img, account photo) and `urn:solid:depiction` (foaf:depiction, any depiction) are related; pick `image` when matching schema.org / OGP semantics, `urn:solid:img` for explicit FOAF profile usage.

history.note: Initial term — property form completing the Image/image case-pair (Image is foaf:Image; image is schema:image).
seeAlso uses registry terms (img, depiction) plus ImageObject/hasPhoto/thumbnail; added img/depiction confusables.
